title: Reliability and Failover
description: Failover readiness, backup restoration, database high availability, and alerting.

title: Observability and Monitoring
description: Metrics collection, dashboards, centralised logging, and alerting across all infrastructure.

title: Automatic database failover
description:
If the primary goes down, failover is currently manual or undefined. Automated promotion and connection routing are needed so there is no scramble during an outage.

Ties into the broader reliability work.

title: Verify backup restore procedure
description:
Base backups are running on schedule but no restore has been performed against them. Recovery time and recovery viability are both currently unknown.

A restore into a non-production environment needs to be performed and the procedure documented as a runbook.

title: Deploy metrics collector to remaining hosts
description:
Several hosts have no metrics collector installed, leaving blind spots in the fleet. Database hosts additionally need the database plugin enabled, which is separate from installing the collector.

Coverage should be verified against the host inventory once the rollout completes.
